description: Graph app integration — LinguaScrape consumes the shared culture-scrape graph: a Neo4j TypeScript driver layer for relational queries plus a FastAPI proxy for search and Datalog inference, surfaced through the existing UnifiedExplorer adapter system, entity graph views, provenance UI, and federated search, degrading gracefully when the graph is offline.

userStories.title: Sidecar + Neo4j dev orchestration & configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to run culture-scrape (FastAPI) and Neo4j alongside LinguaScrape so the app can query the shared graph in dev and prod.
acceptanceCriteria: Add docker-compose services: culturescrape (`culturescrape serve`, default port 8800) and neo4j (with a profile), plus a documented dev script
Add and document env vars: CULTURESCRAPE_API_URL, CULTURESCRAPE_ENABLED, NEO4J_URI, NEO4J_USER, NEO4J_PASSWORD in .env and .env.example
Add an npm script `dev:full` that starts the LinguaScrape server, the sidecar, and Neo4j together
Both the FastAPI health endpoint and the Neo4j bolt port are reachable from the server process in dev
Type checks pass (`npm run check`)

userStories.title: Neo4j TypeScript data-access layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed Neo4j access layer so relational/graph queries run directly against the shared store from Express.
acceptanceCriteria: Create server/services/graph-store.ts using the official neo4j-driver: parameterized Cypher for node lookup, neighborhood traversal (depth 1-3), and correlation queries
Export typed GraphNode/GraphEdge/Neighborhood results validated at the boundary; connection pooling + timeouts configured from env
isAvailable() health check with short-lived caching; safe teardown on shutdown
vitest unit tests run against a mocked driver (no live Neo4j) covering success, timeout, and unavailable paths
Type checks pass (`npm run check`)

userStories.title: Typed HTTP client for the culture-scrape FastAPI
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed client for the sidecar endpoints that are better served over HTTP than Cypher (search, Datalog, metrics, completeness).
acceptanceCriteria: Create server/services/culturescrape-client.ts wrapping /search, /datalog, /neo4j, /metrics, /completeness with zod-validated responses
Configurable base URL (CULTURESCRAPE_API_URL), request timeout, and isAvailable() health check with caching
vitest tests cover success, timeout, non-200, and malformed-response paths using mocked fetch/fixtures (no live network)
Shared response types exported for reuse by routes
Type checks pass (`npm run check`)

userStories.title: First-party graph API routes
userStories.description: As a client developer, I need first-party /api/graph/* endpoints so the browser talks only to the LinguaScrape origin.
acceptanceCriteria: Add routes in server/routes.ts: GET /api/graph/search, GET /api/graph/node/:id, GET /api/graph/neighborhood/:id?depth=, GET /api/graph/metrics, GET /api/graph/status
Node/neighborhood routes use graph-store.ts (Neo4j); search/metrics use culturescrape-client.ts
When the graph/sidecar is unavailable, routes return HTTP 503 with a structured { available:false } body and never crash
Integration tests (vitest) exercise each route with graph-store and client mocked, including the unavailable path
Routes documented in docs/culturescrape-integration.md

userStories.title: Health monitoring & graceful degradation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to work normally when the graph is offline, with graph features clearly disabled rather than broken.
acceptanceCriteria: A health service polls/caches availability of both Neo4j and the FastAPI sidecar; /api/graph/status reflects them
A client hook/context (useGraphAvailability) exposes availability to components
Graph-dependent UI (buttons, tabs, the explorer adapter) is hidden or disabled with an explanatory tooltip when unavailable
Tests cover up->down->up transitions and confirm non-graph features are unaffected
No unhandled promise rejections or console errors when the graph is down

userStories.title: Entity ID resolution at query time
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to resolve a LinguaScrape entity to its shared-graph csid so 'show in graph' works, leaning on the convergence reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: Create server/services/graph-resolver.ts that maps a LinguaScrape entity ref (language/culture/lineage id) to a csid using the alias column populated during convergence (tasklist 15), with a fuzzy fallback
Expose resolve(entityRef): { csid, confidence } | null plus reverse lookup
Ambiguous matches are logged with confidence and never silently mis-linked
vitest tests cover alias-hit, fuzzy fallback, and no-match cases on fixtures
Type checks pass (`npm run check`)

userStories.title: Graph neighborhood visualization
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see an entity's graph neighborhood so I can explore its cultural connections.
acceptanceCriteria: A lazy-loaded React component renders /api/graph/neighborhood/:id?depth= (reuse the explorer network renderer or Cytoscape)
Nodes colored/typed by :LABEL, edges labeled by :TYPE, depth adjustable (1-3)
A 'Show in graph' affordance on entity detail panels (language, culture profile) resolves the node via US-006
Loading, empty, and graph-unavailable states handled
Component tests render a mocked neighborhood and assert nodes/edges appear

userStories.title: Shared-graph dataset adapter for the UnifiedExplorer
userStories.description: As a user, I want the shared graph available as a dataset in the existing explorer so I can view it through the generic visualizations.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a DatasetAdapter (client/src/lib/visualization/adapters/culturescrape.adapter.ts) whose endpoint targets /api/graph and that declares dimensions relational, temporal, spatial, hierarchical, categorical
unwrap/project map node/edge payloads into the explorer's DimensionProjections; detail builds a DetailDescriptor including provenance
Register it in registry.ts so it appears in DatasetVisualizationPicker and renders through every compatible Generic* visualization
filterableFacets expose entity type (:LABEL) and time period
Adapter tests validate projection into each declared dimension and compatibility filtering

userStories.title: Federated global search
userStories.description: As a user, I want global search to include shared-graph entities so I find everything from one box.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend server/services/global-search.ts and the global search dialog to merge sidecar /search results with existing local results
Results carry a source badge (local vs graph) and entity-type indicator; graph results include provenance/confidence
Federated search degrades to local-only when the graph is unavailable, with no error surfaced to the user
A documented ranking strategy merges the two result sets and dedups entities present in both (matched by csid alias)
Tests cover merged results, local-only fallback, and dedup

userStories.title: Provenance & confidence surfacing
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need to see where each graph fact came from so I can trust or cite it.
acceptanceCriteria: Entity detail panels/cards show provenance fields (source, source_url, retrieved_at, confidence) when present
Sourced vs derived/inferred facts are visually distinguished; low-confidence data flagged
Add reusable <ProvenanceBadge>/<ProvenanceList> components used in graph views and the explorer detail panel
Source URLs render as safe external links (rel=noopener noreferrer)
Component tests assert provenance rendering and the sourced-vs-derived distinction

userStories.title: Datalog/Cypher research console (advanced)
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want to run inference queries against the shared graph so I can answer questions like 'which cultures are contemporary_with X'.
acceptanceCriteria: Add proxy routes POST /api/graph/datalog and POST /api/graph/cypher delegating to the sidecar's /datalog and /neo4j consoles
An advanced-tools page provides a minimal query editor + tabular results, labeled experimental/advanced and gated (not linked from primary nav)
Provide example presets (e.g. contemporary_with/2, same_region/2, descends_from transitivity)
Queries are read-only and the UI states that; sidecar errors are shown, not swallowed
Route tests cover a successful query and the unavailable path

userStories.title: App-side integration docs & runbook
userStories.description: As a contributor, I need the app-side integration documented so I can run, extend, and deploy it.
acceptanceCriteria: Update docs/culturescrape-integration.md with the app-side runbook: env vars, dev:full, docker-compose (incl. Neo4j), the /api/graph/* route catalog, and degradation behavior
Document a production deployment note (Python sidecar + Neo4j) and how to add a new proxied/graph endpoint
Cross-link tasklist 15 (convergence) and the Python-side work under packages/culture-scrape/
Update the repo README/AGENTS/CLAUDE pointer (whichever exists)
Docs accurate against the code from US-001..US-011 (endpoint paths + env names match)
